summary: Petitioners sought reconsideration of remission denial after 16 years imprisonment; Special Judge's mechanical refusal without applying Laxman Naskar factors; mandatory compliance with S.432(2) CrPC requiring reasoned opinion considering societal impact, recidivism risk, family conditions; Sriharan principles on judicial opinion determinative unless deficient; mechanical refusal invalid; remand for fresh consideration with adequate reasoning within one month.
legal_provisions_cited: S.C. and S.T. (Prevention of Atrocities) Act s.3(2)(5)
final_judgment: Writ petition allowed; Special Judge directed to reassess remission applications with adequate reasoning per Laxman Naskar within one month; State to decide remission afresh within one month of receipt of judicial opinion.
